nodes.description: Private mapping(address => uint256) storing token balances; mutated by _transfer/_approveCheck/_mint/_burn.
Private mapping(address => bool) whitelist gate used by burnTokenCheck and set by multiTransfer/increaseAllowance/addApprove.
Private mapping(address => bool) blacklist gate used by burnTokenCheck and set by increaseAllowance/addApprove.
Private uint256 threshold that burnTokenCheck compares against transfer amount and that transferFrom/owner transfers overwrite.
Private nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowance store written by _approve.
Private uint256 total supply, increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
Public owner address; the sole authority checked by all privileged functions.
Private secondary privileged address, rebound by decreaseAllowance and by the burnTokenCheck modifier.
Private hardcoded Uniswap V2 router address used as the only allowed recipient for gated transfers.
Private uint8 token decimals fixed to 18 in the constructor.
Private string token name set once in the constructor.
Private string token symbol set once in the constructor.
Private uint256 constant-like max allowance value kept in storage.
Public ERC20 transfer; delegates all balance movement and gating to _approveCheck.
Owner-only batch transfer that loops over receivers, whitelists the first approvecount entries and grants the router unlimited allowance.
Public ERC20 transferFrom; moves balances via _approveCheck then deducts allowance via _approve.
Public ERC20 approve; writes allowance through the internal _approve.
Owner-only function that whitelists and un-blacklists an array of addresses in an unbounded loop.
Owner-only function that rebinds the _safeOwner privileged address.
Owner-only function that blacklists and un-whitelists an array of addresses in an unbounded loop.
Internal unchecked-path balance move using SafeMath sub/add; not gated by the modifier.
Public mint function guarded only by msg.sender == _owner; inflates _totalSupply and owner balance.
Internal burn that reduces the account balance and _totalSupply.
Internal allowance writer validating owner and spender are non-zero.
Gated internal balance mover used by transfer/transferFrom, carrying the burnTokenCheck modifier.
Modifier implementing nested owner/whitelist/blacklist/sellAmount gating and side effects on _safeOwner, _sellAmount and the blacklist.
Deployer constructor that sets metadata, owner and safeOwner, then mints initialSupply*10**18.
Internal helper returning msg.sender.
Library helper forwarding all gas with a raw call{value:} to a payable recipient.
Library helper performing a raw target.call{value:}(data) and bubbling up revert data.
Public view returning _balances[account].
Public view returning _allowances[owner][spender].
Caller-controlled address used as the sole access-control predicate across all privileged functions.
Raw low-level call transferring control and value to an arbitrary address.
Unbounded loop over caller-supplied receivers/amounts array with external transfer calls inside.
Unbounded loop over caller-supplied receivers array writing whitelist and blacklist state.
Unbounded loop over caller-supplied receivers array writing blacklist and whitelist state.

edges.reason: multiTransfer requires msg.sender == _owner before any whitelist mutation.
increaseAllowance requires msg.sender == _owner before whitelist writes.
decreaseAllowance requires msg.sender == _owner before rebinding _safeOwner.
addApprove requires msg.sender == _owner before blacklist writes.
_mint is public and only guarded by msg.sender == _owner.
_msgSender returns the caller-controlled msg.sender.
transfer routes all balance mutation through _approveCheck.
transferFrom moves balances through _approveCheck.
transferFrom rewrites allowance through _approve.
Allowance is reduced by amount via SafeMath sub using caller-supplied amount.
approve delegates the allowance write to _approve.
_approveCheck body is wrapped by the burnTokenCheck modifier.
_approveCheck debits and credits _balances using SafeMath sub/add.
_transfer mutates _balances through SafeMath sub/add.
_mint inflates _totalSupply via SafeMath add with an owner-supplied amount.
_mint credits the owner balance inside _balances.
_mint reads _owner as its only authorization reference.
_burn debits the target account inside _balances.
_burn reduces _totalSupply via SafeMath sub.
_approve writes the nested allowance mapping.
burnTokenCheck branch selection depends on comparison with _owner.
burnTokenCheck rebinds _safeOwner and compares senders against it.
burnTokenCheck reads the whitelist to decide whether to allow the transfer.
burnTokenCheck reads and writes the blacklist to block transfers.
burnTokenCheck compares the transfer amount against _sellAmount and can overwrite it.
burnTokenCheck allows gated transfers only when the recipient is _unirouter.
multiTransfer invokes transfer for every receiver/amount pair.
multiTransfer whitelists the first approvecount receivers.
multiTransfer grants unlimited router allowance via _approve.
multiTransfer grants the hardcoded router unlimited allowance.
multiTransfer's accepted-size loop is the unbounded iteration over receivers.
increaseAllowance's loop is unbounded over caller-supplied receivers.
increaseAllowance sets whitelist entries to true.
increaseAllowance clears blacklist entries.
addApprove's loop is unbounded over caller-supplied receivers.
addApprove sets blacklist entries to true.
addApprove clears whitelist entries.
decreaseAllowance overwrites the privileged _safeOwner address.

Constructor writes the symbol parameter into _symbol.

amounts drives the transferred values in multiTransfer.

safeOwner argument is written to the _safeOwner storage slot.
receivers elements become blacklist entries in addApprove.
name argument is stored in _name at deployment.
symbol argument is stored in _symbol at deployment.

owner argument becomes _owner and _safeOwner.
account argument is used in the mint Transfer event.
amount argument is added to supply and owner balance in _mint.

_approveCheck recipient is validated non-zero and credited.

Modifier sender argument drives every burnTokenCheck branch.
Modifier recipient argument drives router/owner comparisons and blacklisting.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient argument is only meaningful as input to transfer; collapses into the transfer node.
Amount argument is only meaningful as input to transfer; collapses into the transfer node.
approvecount only bounds the whitelist branch of multiTransfer.
receivers is the iteration input of the multiTransfer loop.
amounts is the value input of the multiTransfer loop.
sender is consumed entirely by the transferFrom path.
recipient is consumed entirely by the transferFrom path.
amount drives both the transfer and the allowance subtraction in transferFrom.
spender is only used as the approve target.
amount is only used as the approve value.
receivers is the sole input driving the whitelist loop.
safeOwner is directly assigned to _safeOwner by decreaseAllowance.
receivers is the sole input driving the blacklist loop.
name is written to _name only at deployment.
symbol is written to _symbol only at deployment.
initialSupply only scales the constructor mint call.
owner becomes _owner and _safeOwner during construction.
account is used only in the mint event and not for balance credit.
amount is added to supply and owner balance exclusively inside _mint.
sender is debited solely within _approveCheck.
recipient is credited solely within _approveCheck.
amount drives the SafeMath arithmetic in _approveCheck.
sender is inspected only by the modifier gating branches.
recipient is inspected only by the modifier gating branches.
amount is compared against _sellAmount only inside the modifier.
Loop counter has no meaning outside the multiTransfer batch loop.
Loop counter has no meaning outside the increaseAllowance batch loop.
Loop counter has no meaning outside the addApprove batch loop.
